svg.title: The Paddock family
svg.desc: Seven local-first desktop apps. Pacenotes (in design), Debrief and Sighter (in design) on top; Spotter, Dyno and Pitcrew below; Pitwall, the local AI hub, between them. All built on the shared Paddock foundation.
svg.text: Seven local-first tools for people who keep systems running
One private AI hub, one shared foundation. Each app is good alone and better together.

g.text: The local AI hub for the family.
Every app can use it. None needs it.
The shared foundation under every app.
